description: Gantt with Enablers is a Power BI custom visual designed for project portfolio management. It presents your projects, operations, and enablers in a single, interactive Gantt diagram with collapsible hierarchy, dynamic colors, and a configurable today line — giving both executives and operations teams full visibility in one report. Whether you manage a handful of projects or a large portfolio with multiple levels of enablers, the visual adapts to your data structure and your company's design needs through an extensive set of formatting options. Key features: Collapsible hierarchy — up to 5 levels (projects, operations, main enablers, sub-enablers, processes, and detentions), expandable and collapsible interactively Dynamic colors — bar, line, badge, and icon colors driven directly from dataset columns, no manual formatting required Progress tracking — progress bars with percentage badges, configurable height, corner radius, and display options Enablers as diamond lines — enablers rendered as dashed lines with a diamond endpoint and a configurable progress badge Today line — visual indicator of the current date on the timeline, with configurable color, thickness, and opacity Flexible timeline — FY/Quarter headers with configurable padding, grid color, and row height Rich tooltips — description and target fields visible on hover Column labels — configurable width, font, and text…
